# Render goldens: chat work rows (`turn-rows.json`)

What the iOS chat (對談) mode shows for each **run of work**, per golden case — the gate for the Mac chat
(U3 plan D9, `docs/plans/2026-10-10-interface-u3-plan.md`). The Mac test reads **only this file**; it never builds a
local replacement.

## Format

```
{ "version": 1, "rules": "<one paragraph>",
  "cases": [ { "name": "<MANIFEST case>", "source": "cc-transcript",
               "turns": [ { "turn_id", "index", "runs": [ { "step_ids": [...], "running": bool, "text": "...", "latest"? } ] } ],
               "children"?: [ { "agent_id": "...", "turns": [ same shape ] } ] } ] }
```

- One entry per MANIFEST case, in MANIFEST order. A turn with no step has no entry in `turns` (a case with no
  work at all has `"turns": []`).
- A **run** = consecutive steps of a turn; `thinking` does not break it, `user` / `agent_text` / `system` / notes do.
  `step_ids` lists the run's steps in order; every step of a turn is in exactly one run.
- `text` (finished run) = `處理了 <span> · N 個<類別>、… · N 失敗 · N 已拒絕 · N 已中斷`, with the plan's D9 rules
  (kind order 指令 編輯 讀取 搜尋 網頁 子 agent 其他; zero counts left out; span = max(started_at + duration_ms) −
  min(started_at), rounded to seconds, `N 秒` / `N 分` / `N 分 M 秒` / `N 時` / `N 時 M 分`).
  The text uses ASCII spaces; iOS draws U+00A0 around the numbers of the three trailing parts (失敗 / 已拒絕 /
  已中斷) as a line-break hint only.
- A run that contains a **running** step is iOS's live progress message (「正在：<latest>」 and a ticking clock):
  `running` is `true`, `text` is `null` and `latest` is `<類別> <step summary>`. The current golden cases have no
  such run.
- `children` are the subagent files of the case (`cc-transcript/<case>/children/<agentId>.expected.json`): each is one
  pseudo-turn, its runs are computed the same way. A parent's subagent step counts as one step (類別 子 agent).

## How it is made

Generated by purdex-ios from its own code (`DialogueRows` / `DeckGrouping`), tested there
(`TurnRowsFixtureTests`: the committed file must equal what iOS produces, and every step must land in exactly one
run):

```
TEST_RUNNER_WRITE_TURN_ROWS=<out path> xcodebuild -project Purdex.xcodeproj -scheme Purdex -destination <iPhone SE 3 sim> \
  -only-testing:PurdexTests/TurnRowsFixtureTests/testWriteWhenAsked test
```

Made from the fixtures at purdex `0ed33056` (iOS pins the same commit) with purdex-ios commit
`8c0b09d032f90a0943824b640553daf50fdbb88a` (`github.com/wake/purdex-ios`, `App/Tests/TurnRowsFixtureTests.swift`).
When the golden cases change or iOS changes the row rules, regenerate and re-commit this file; the iOS test fails
until both sides agree.
